Ravi (oncall): FYI team — starting 2026-04-05T11:05 UTC we are seeing auth-db connection saturation in ap-southeast-1 causing intermittent 502s from edge-auth-proxy and elevated token issuance latency. Declaring incident. Severity: S2. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2176001111 | Runbook: https://redwood.app/ops/incidents/2176001111

auth-bot: alert: db_conn_pool_exhaustion ap-southeast-1 at 11:05:12 UTC (connections_in_use=198/200).

Lena: Tracing shows a spike of short-lived bursts from a job in the telemetry ingestion path creating many auth checks. I'm throttling that job queue from 100 -> 10 concurrent workers as emergency mitigation: `jobsctl scale telemetry-auth-bridge --concurrency=10 --region=ap-southeast-1`.

DB Team: Noted a surge in active connections and CPU on auth-db-primary. Increasing connection_pool_size on proxy side to 400 temporarily and rotating a read-replica to accept auth traffic: `proxyctl set conn_pool=400 --service=edge-auth-proxy --region ap-southeast-1`.

deploy-bot: proxy config change applied at 11:09:02 UTC 10s window: conn_pool 200->400. status: success.

Ravi (oncall): After mitigations, 502 rate decreased from 2.8% -> 0.2% over 5m, token issue p95 improved 640ms -> 280ms. Monitoring heatmap and DB CPU.

Telemetry: Query: `sum(rate(auth_502_total[1m])) by (region)` shows the ap-southeast-1 spike cleared. Will add per-job auth-check metric to owners' dashboard.

Customer Success: Posting short update to status page and contacting impacted customers: "We experienced intermittent auth failures in ap-southeast-1; mitigations applied and services are recovering. RCA to follow." Draft link: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2176001111

DB Team: Next steps: investigate root cause of bursty connections from telemetry-auth-bridge, add circuit-breaker on proxy for high-connection-rate clients, and add auto-scaling for replicas under connection pressure. Owner: DB Team.

Lena: I'll produce a minimal repro and include the job id and timing; also adding a preflight check to the telemetry deployment pipeline to detect auth call fan-out >50/s per job.

Ravi (oncall): Current status: mitigated, services stable in ap-southeast-1, monitoring for 60m. RCA owners: DB Team (connection handling), Lena (job), Telemetry (dashboards). Closing thread unless recurrence. Thanks all.
